description: This file defines the ResourceTypeRepository class in Drupal's JSON:API module, responsible for managing and retrieving JSON:API resource types based on entity types and bundles. It includes methods for creating resource type objects, caching, and handling entity field definitions.

classes.name: ResourceTypeRepository
classes.description: Manages JSON:API resource types, providing methods to retrieve, create, and cache resource type objects based on entity types and bundles.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Retrieves all resource types, using cache if available, and generates them if not.

methods.name: createResourceType
methods.description: Creates a ResourceType object for a given entity type and bundle, dispatching build events and determining resource type properties.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific resource type by entity type ID and bundle, using cache.

methods.name: getByTypeName
methods.description: Retrieves a resource type by its type name.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Generates field mappings for a resource type based on entity fields and definitions.

methods.name: getAllFieldNames
methods.description: Returns all field names for a given entity type and bundle.

methods.name: isMutableResourceType
methods.description: Determines if a resource type is mutable based on entity type.

methods.name: isLocatableResourceType
methods.description: Checks if a resource type can be located (has storage).

methods.name: isVersionableResourceType
methods.description: Checks if a resource type supports revisions.

methods.name: calculateRelatableResourceTypes
methods.description: Calculates related resource types for relationships in a resource type.

methods.name: getRelatableResourceTypesFromFieldDefinition
methods.description: Determines related resource types from a field definition.

methods.name: isReferenceFieldDefinition
methods.description: Checks if a field definition is a reference (relationship) field.

methods.name: getAllBundlesForEntityType
methods.description: Returns all bundle IDs for a given entity type.

methods.name: lookupResourceType
methods.description: Finds a resource type by entity type ID and bundle from a list.
